title: Three Years and One Short Letter
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：love　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 love 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the grandmother ① gave the love that no child in the courtyard would have recorded, and he said the giving was the whole of the year. The ② love, meaning the care itself and not the letter, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; love, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ bit of love in that courtyard had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ love at the far window, meaning the promise they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Love, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grandmother said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the love was the whole of the matter, meaning the kindness and not the care. The ⑥ love, meaning the kindness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; love, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both care and a kindness. He said the kindness is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ love had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ love of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of recording; love, he said, is either the promise at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ love I remember is the love recorded in the diary, which closed in 1968 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtyard. ⑩ Love, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all love, she said, is a kindness that has agreed to look like care. She said the kindness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 爱；关爱（指院子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 爱；关爱（指那份爱意本身，与信相对）
C. 固定搭配：give the love 给予这一份爱
D. n. 爱；关爱（指留给孩子们守着的那一句那一份）
E. n. 爱意之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的爱之事）
F. n. 爱；关爱（指日记里写到、被记载的的那一份）
G. n. 善意、温情（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 温情（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: gave the love that no child in the courtyard would have recorded
The love, meaning the care itself and not the letter
Every bit of love in that courtyard
the love at the far window
the love was the whole of the matter
the love had become a line in a diary
The love of the whole thing

answers.why: give the love 意为“给予这一份爱”，1961 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯记载的一份爱做了一遍。
love 意为“爱；关爱”，指那份爱意本身而不是信，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
love 意为“爱；关爱”，指院子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
love 意为“爱；关爱”，指最远那扇窗边留给孩子们守着的那一句那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
love 意为“善意、温情”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份善意就是那件事的全部。
love 意为“温情”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份爱意，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
love 意为“爱；关爱”，指日记里写到、被记载的的那一份，到 1966 年这一份成了日记里的一行。
love 意为“爱意之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的爱之事是一处院子和三个年头的记载。
love 意为“爱；关爱”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一份，1968 年写完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一份。
love 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，爱是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的爱意。
